milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining gravel produces flint as a drop (~10% chance per block, 30 blocks available). The player starts with NO flint in inventory, so having flint proves gravel was successfully mined. Note: flint may be consumed when crafting flint_and_steel, but the evaluator uses latching/sticky milestone evaluation — once a milestone is marked complete, it stays complete even if the condition later becomes false.

Uses inventory_has because crafting flint_and_steel places the item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with NO flint_and_steel, so having one proves it was crafted from flint (obtained by mining gravel) + iron_ingot (provided at scene start). The recipe fits in a 2x2 grid so the crafting table is optional but available.
